components.name: Sun Button
components.description: Primary warm action used for waitlist entry.
components.css: .ds-btn-sun { min-height:52px; min-width:205px; display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; gap:1.5rem; padding:.9rem 1.2rem; border:0; border-radius:999px; background:var(--amber,#ffaa2b); color:var(--ink,#180c2b); font:800 1rem Manrope,sans-serif; transition:transform 220ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1),background-color 220ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-btn-sun:hover { transform:translateY(-2px); background:var(--paper,#fff7e9); } .ds-btn-sun:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--amber,#ffaa2b); outline-offset:4px; }

components.name: Ink Button
components.css: .ds-btn-ink { min-height:52px; width:100%; display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; gap:1.5rem; padding:.9rem 1.2rem; border:0; border-radius:999px; background:var(--ink,#180c2b); color:var(--paper,#fff7e9); font:800 1rem Manrope,sans-serif; transition:transform 220ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1),background-color 220ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-btn-ink:hover { transform:translateY(-2px); background:var(--violet,#6d2c91); } .ds-btn-ink:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--amber,#ffaa2b); outline-offset:4px; }

components.name: Underline Field
components.description: Paper-like form field with a magenta focus rule.
components.css: .ds-field { display:grid; gap:.55rem; color:var(--ink,#180c2b); font:800 .78rem Manrope,sans-serif; } .ds-field input { min-height:52px; padding:.8rem 0; border:0; border-bottom:1px solid rgba(24,12,43,.44); border-radius:0; outline:none; background:transparent; color:var(--ink,#180c2b); font:400 1rem Manrope,sans-serif; } .ds-field input:focus { border-bottom-color:var(--magenta,#ec2d7c); box-shadow:0 2px 0 var(--magenta,#ec2d7c); } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--amber,#ffaa2b); outline-offset:4px; }

components.name: Event Stamp
components.description: Ticket-like confirmed event metadata over photography.
components.css: .ds-event-stamp { display:inline-flex; padding:.65rem .8rem; border:1px solid rgba(255,247,233,.44); border-radius:999px; background:rgba(24,12,43,.72); color:var(--paper,#fff7e9); font:400 .75rem 'IBM Plex Mono',monospace; letter-spacing:.08em; text-transform:uppercase; }

components.name: Hero Navigation
components.description: Minimal navigation that keeps the waitlist action present over the hero.
components.css: .ds-nav { display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; gap:2rem; padding:1.4rem clamp(1.25rem,4vw,4.5rem); border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,247,233,.28); background:var(--ink,#180c2b); color:var(--paper,#fff7e9); } .ds-nav strong { font:800 2rem 'Barlow Condensed',sans-serif; letter-spacing:.04em; } .ds-nav a { min-height:44px; display:inline-flex; align-items:center; padding:.72rem 1.1rem; border:1px solid rgba(255,247,233,.76); border-radius:999px; color:inherit; font:700 .82rem Manrope,sans-serif; text-decoration:none; } .ds-nav a:hover { background:var(--paper,#fff7e9); color:var(--ink,#180c2b); } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--amber,#ffaa2b); outline-offset:4px; }

components.description: The only broadly elevated surface, reserved for conversion.

components.name: Then and Now Handle
components.description: The tactile control at the center of the matched crew portrait.
components.css: .ds-memory-handle { width:64px; height:64px; display:grid; place-items:center; border:2px solid var(--ink,#180c2b); border-radius:50%; background:var(--amber,#ffaa2b); color:var(--ink,#180c2b); font:600 .65rem 'IBM Plex Mono',monospace; text-transform:uppercase; cursor:ew-resize; } .ds-memory-handle:hover { transform:scale(1.04); } .ds-memory-handle:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--amber,#ffaa2b); outline-offset:4px; }

narrative.overview:
Reunion feels like a festival poster that has come alive around a group of old friends. It is loud in scale but warm in intent: photographic, editorial, and unmistakably human. Condensed type, saturated blocks of colour, pass-like metadata, and deep ink fields supply the event energy; cream paper, candid group imagery, and direct language keep the experience intimate.

The system is deliberately disciplined. Each section has one clear compositional gesture, with the Then & Now comparison carrying the signature interaction. The interface does not borrow spectacle from an invented stage or lineup; the visual hierarchy consistently makes the crew the hero.
keyCharacteristics: Oversized, tightly set condensed headlines with short line lengths.
Warm, full-bleed group photography treated as editorial evidence, not decoration.
Saturated amber, coral, violet, and magenta used as sectional fields against ink and paper.
Mono metadata that evokes tickets, passes, dates, and crew records.
Mostly flat surfaces, with depth reserved for the interactive photograph and conversion form.

rules.name: The Warm Contrast Rule
rules.body: Use warm paper rather than pure white, and midnight ink rather than black; the palette should feel printed and lived-in, not clinical.

rules.name: The Section Field Rule
rules.body: Saturated colour belongs to a whole message or action area. Do not sprinkle every accent into the same composition.

rules.name: The Poster Voice Rule
rules.body: Use the condensed face for short declarations, never for paragraphs or form instructions.

rules.name: The Evidence Voice Rule
rules.body: Use the mono face only for facts and metadata; its scarcity makes event details feel trustworthy.

rules.name: The Two Shadows Rule
rules.body: Do not add generic card shadows. Depth is reserved for the signature comparison and the conversion surface.

dos: Do make the people and their shared history the visual subject.
Do let one oversized statement lead each section.
Do use the mono voice for confirmed logistics, indices, and crew metadata.
Do provide a complete non-animated reading path and replace pointer-only interactions on mobile.
Do use accent fields boldly, one dominant colour at a time.
donts: Don't invent performers, crowd scenes, testimonials, or social proof.
Don't turn the interface into a collection of floating cards or generic SaaS components.
Don't mix every accent colour inside one section without a semantic reason.
Don't add decorative motion beyond the signature comparison and restrained state feedback.
Don't use pure black, pure white, or a system display face as a shortcut.
